newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.

LIVE CATTLE - steady to 0.10 cent lower. Talk that packers bought most of the cattle they needed on Wednesday at $64.00 per cwt and trade should be slow in the cash market Thursday. Market should be underpinned by strength in wholesale beef market. There may, however, be some profit-taking in futures ahead of Friay's key USDA cattle reports.

FEEDER CATTLE - 0.10 to 0.25 cent lower. Market could be vulnerable to bouts of profit-taking after Wednesday's run-up to the highest level for the nearby contract since March 1994. Overnight gains in CBOT corn may also weigh on prices early. Wednesday's close above the key 82 cent level on August may, however, prompt some chart-based buying.

LEAN HOGS - 0.10 to 0.25 cent lower. Packers appear to have all the hogs they need and the cash market looks set to be $0.50 to $1.00 lower on Thursday. Strength in product may, however, underpin the market.
PORK BELLIES - steady. Cash fresh pork belly market has been strengthening but there is some concern that a modest pick-up in the hog slaughter could soon stall the recent run-up in product values.
